adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: The old code was `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` which would return the externalId from destinationCalendar as fallback. The new code is `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When externalCalendarId is undefined/null (the else branch), this find() will look for a calendar where externalId === undefined, which will likely return undefined instead of falling back to any destination calendar. This breaks the fallback behavior for legacy bookings that don't have externalCalendarId set.
